title: 735. Self Dividing Numbers

examples.explanation: Values with a zero digit or a non-dividing digit are left out.

hints: Test each candidate by repeatedly taking x % 10 as the current digit and x / 10 as the remainder.
Reject immediately on a zero digit; otherwise require num % digit == 0 for every digit.
The interval holds at most 10000 values, so a direct scan is fast enough.
